subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-09-25
html:
Weekly Pulse — Sept 25, 2026

~12 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords checked day-by-day 9/18→9/25 (not just the 8 above) — every single one sat at position 0/not-ranked on every day. Zero movement, zero exceptions.

Traffic vs last week

Estimated organic traffic: 0, unchanged. SE Ranking's domain overview returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — the domain still has no organic footprint to drive traffic from, consistent with the flat rank data above.

Anything broken?

No. Last 6 SEO Report Email runs (09-14 through 09-24) all green, 41/41 all-time. Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (3rd week flat). AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists yet; this needs a human to set up in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all. catalog.ts's 8 gated connectors (meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages, tiktok_ads/stripe, hubspot/mailerlite, mailchimp) and the destinations catalog (Excel/Snowflake/Redshift/Databricks all still coming_soon/waitlist) are both unchanged from last week — no new content lever opened up.

Reading the week

Nothing moved, and that's expected at this stage: a brand-new domain (DA 0) is roughly 12 weeks into a strategy that frames month 1–3 as leading indicators, not rankings — this is week ~12, still pre-ranking. The MCP-integration wedge itself keeps growing fast in the underlying data (claude mcp server 910/mo, mcp connector 880/mo, google analytics mcp 590/mo — all already targeted by live pages), so the keyword thesis isn't the bottleneck. The two things actually worth a human's attention this week: (1) the AI Result Tracker has never been configured, so there's still no way to see whether any of this GEO-optimized content is actually surfacing in AI answers — a blind spot on the exact channel the strategy leans on hardest; (2) off-page (0/6 listings) and GSC submission remain untouched since kickoff, and organic can't start moving without either indexation confirmation or any inbound authority beyond 2 referring domains.
